central-america-caribbean.title: Amerik Santral ak Karayib
central-america-caribbean.description: Amerik Santral ak Karayib la — Yukatan, Beliz, Gwatemala, Ondiras, Salvadò, Nikaragwa, Kosta Rika, Panama, Kiba, Jamayik, Ispayola, Zile Kayiman, Pòtoriko, Ti Zantiy yo ak sid Bahamas.

hispaniola.title: Ispayola
hispaniola.description: Zile Ispayola nan Karayib la — Ayiti ak Repiblik Dominikèn.

south-central-us.title: Sid-Santral Etazini
south-central-us.description: Teksas, Oklahoma, Akansas, Lwizyàn, Kentucky, Tennessee, Misisipi ak Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, Nouvèl Orleyan, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson ak Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa ak Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, Samoa Ameriken, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau ak Wallis e Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi ak Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila ak zile Tonga yo.

mariana-islands.title: Gwam ak Zile Mariyàn Nò yo
mariana-islands.description: Gwam ak Zile Mariyàn Nò yo — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian ak Rota.

greenland.title: Greenland
greenland.description: Greenland — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq ak Tasiilaq; gwo kouch glas la, fyò glas Ilulissat la ak fyò nan sid yo.

bermuda.title: Bèmid
bermuda.description: Bèmid — Hamilton, St. George’s ak ansyen chantye marin wayal la, pawas zile a ak plaj sab woz li yo.

belarus.title: Byelorisi
belarus.description: Byelorisi — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno ak Brest; forè Belovezhskaya Pushcha ak marekaj Polesia yo.

channel-islands.title: Zile Lamanch yo
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark ak Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port ak Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Zile Faroe yo
faroe-islands.description: Zile Faroe yo — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík ak dizuit zile yo, ak bouk yo, tinèl yo ak falèz bò lanmè yo.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard ak Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg ak Ny-Ålesund; glasye ak fyò Spitsbergen yo.

malta.title: Malt
malta.description: Malt, Gozo ak Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria ak Twa Vil yo.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaskar ak zile Oseyan Endyen yo
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaskar, Komò, Mayòt, Larenyon, Moris ak Sechèl — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis ak Victoria.

sudan.title: Soudan
sudan.description: Soudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid ak Nyala; kote Nil Ble ak Nil Blan kontre ak piramid Meroë yo.

cabo-verde.title: Kap Vè
cabo-verde.description: Kap Vè — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria ak dis zile yo, soti Santo Antão rive Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: Sao Tome ak Prensip
sao-tome-principe.description: Sao Tome ak Prensip — São Tomé, Santo António ak forè twopikal ak plaj de zile yo.

saint-helena.title: Sent Elèn, Asansyon ak Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Sent Elèn, Zile Asansyon ak Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown ak Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladèch
bangladesh.description: Bangladèch — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet ak Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans ak delta Gang ak Brahmapoutra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka ak Maldiv
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka ak Maldiv — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura ak Malé; zòn mòn yo, Sigiriya ak atòl yo.

vietnam.title: Vyetnam
vietnam.description: Vyetnam — Hanoi, Vil Ho Chi Minh, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An ak Can Tho; Bè Ha Long ak delta Mekong.

philippines.title: Filipin
philippines.description: Filipin — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio ak Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao ak Palawan.

indonesia.title: Endonezi ak Timò Lès
indonesia.description: Endonezi ak Timò Lès — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar ak Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Bòneo, Sulawesi ak Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malezi, Singapou ak Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malezi, Singapou ak Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapou, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching ak Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanma
myanmar.description: Myanma — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine ak Lak Inle; fon larivyè Irrawaddy ak mòn Shan yo.

cambodia-laos.title: Kanbòdj ak Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kanbòdj ak Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap ak Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang ak Pakse; Mekong ak Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolonbi
colombia.description: Kolonbi — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena ak Bucaramanga; mòn Andes yo, kòt Karayib la ak Amazoni.

venezuela.title: Venezwela
venezuela.description: Venezwela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida ak Ciudad Bolívar; Chit Angel, Orinoco ak Zile Margarita.

peru.title: Pewou
peru.description: Pewou — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos ak Puno; Machu Picchu, Lak Titicaca ak Vale Sakre a.

ecuador.title: Ekwatè
ecuador.description: Ekwatè — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta ak Baños; Avni Vòlkan yo, Amazoni ak Zile Galápagos yo.

bolivia.title: Bolivi
bolivia.description: Bolivi — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre ak Potosí; Lak Titicaca ak Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chili
chile.description: Chili — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena ak Punta Arenas; Atacama, Rejyon Lak yo, Patagoni ak Zile Pak.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paragwe ak Irigwe
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paragwe ak Irigwe — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este ak Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Giyàn yo
guianas.description: Giyana, Sirinam ak Giyàn Franse — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Kayèn ak Kourou; Chit Kaieteur ak forè twopikal Plato Giyàn nan.

falklands.title: Zile Malwin yo
falklands.description: Zile Malwin yo (Falkland) — Stanley, Goose Green ak zile East Falkland ak West Falkland.

australia.title: Ostrali
australia.description: Ostrali — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin ak Canberra; Gran Baryè Koray la, Uluru ak Outback la.

new-zealand.title: Nouvèl Zeland
new-zealand.description: Nouvèl Zeland — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin ak Queenstown; Alp Sid yo, Fiordland ak Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: Kolonbi Britanik
british-columbia.description: Kolonbi Britanik — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George ak Whistler; Mòn Kòt yo, Zile Vancouver ak Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Preri Kanadyen yo
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan ak Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina ak Banff; Mòn Woche yo, preri yo ak Churchill bò Bè Hudson.

ontario.title: Ontaryo
ontario.description: Ontaryo — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston ak Thunder Bay; Chit Niagara, Gwo Lak yo ak Pak Algonquin.

quebec.title: Kebèk
quebec.description: Kebèk — Monreyal, vil Kebèk, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke ak Saguenay; Sen Lowan, Laurentides ak Penensil Gaspé.

atlantic-canada.title: Kanada Atlantik
atlantic-canada.description: Nouvo Brunswick, Nouvèl Ekòs, Zile Prens Edward ak Tèrnèv ak Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton ak Charlottetown; Cabot Trail ak Bè Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Nò Kanada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Teritwa Nòdwès yo ak Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City ak Inuvik; Achipèl Aktik la ak Rivyè Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong ak Makao
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong ak Makao — Zile Hong Kong, Kowloon, Nouvo Teritwa yo, Lantau ak Penensil Makao, Taipa ak Coloane.

antarctica.title: Antatik
antarctica.description: Antatik — Estasyon McMurdo, Baz Scott ak Villa Las Estrellas; Penensil Antatik la, zile Shetland disid yo, platfòm glas Ross la ak mòn Erebus. Kat la fini nan 85° sid epi li pa rive nan Pòl Sid la.
